data.narrative:
Dhruva Space is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised ₹27 crore to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of five private peers at Series B and Series C stages, including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and Skyryse, alongside a reference set of six publicly traded aerospace firms (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. The five selected comparables exhibit a wide valuation range from $1.1B to $8.0B, with a median of $1.5B. This median reflects the typical valuation profile for Series B and adjacent-stage space technology companies. A public-comp anchoring approach using Space & Aerospace sector multiples (median P/S of 23.9x across six public tickers) is not applicable, as target revenue has not been disclosed—a constraint common to private company analysis.

The triangulated valuation range supported by this analysis is $1.3B to $1.7B, with a median estimate of $1.5B. This range is narrow relative to the peer universe spread, reflecting the concentration of comparable valuations in the mid-to-lower end of the sector. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue or profitability metrics for the target, the substantial valuation outlier (Sierra Space at $8.0B), and limited visibility into post-Series B funding trajectories within the space subsector.
